ai_summary: This document details an inter-se transfer of 7.19% of Aakash Exploration Services Limited shares between two existing promoters, Mr. Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria and Mr. Vihan Vipul Haria. The shares are being transferred as a gift, without monetary consideration, and the transaction is exempt from triggering a public open offer under SEBI regulations. This represents an internal re-alignment of shareholding within the promoter group, resulting in no material change to overall promoter control or direct impact on public shareholders, and no immediate red flags are identified.
